lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. Spots are arranged in a staggered grid with approximately 4 to 5 visible nodes per column along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, positioning each circular cluster centrally within the vertical bands to form a structural grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance crests to low-luminance troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible in the ventral area below the head and pectoral fin.
